newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank sets single tender at unchanged 3.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank sets single tender at unchanged 3.0 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said it was setting a tender for 14-day securities repurchase funds, offering banks liquidity at a fixed rate of 3.0 percent.
Funds will be credited to accounts tomorrow and the securities have to be repurchased on August 20.
A 72.1 billion mark facility, also set at a fixed interest rate of three percent, expires on Wednesday.

The Bundesbank made no comment on any other money market activities. There had been some speculation that the central bank could announce an additional tender at variable interest rates which would effectively allow repo rates to drift higher.
